system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "AI danger withholding narrative",
    "detail": "Framing AI model secrecy as evidence of unprecedented danger rather than corporate risk assessment or marketing strategy.",
    "debias": "Report AI model restrictions as company decisions without amplifying danger claims as validation.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-14",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Anthropic's most powerful new AI model, Mythos, is too dangerous to release to the public, the company says, sparking urgent discussions with governments and financial regulators.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/next/2026/04/14/why-anthropics-new-mythos-ai-model-has-washington-and-wall-street-worked-up",
    "unbiased_text": "Anthropic has restricted public access to its new AI model, Mythos, citing safety concerns and prompting discussions with regulators."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "War profiteering beneficiary highlighting",
    "detail": "Emphasizing how specific countries economically benefit from conflicts through increased exports, framing war-driven price spikes as windfalls.",
    "debias": "Report economic impacts neutrally, noting both price increases and their causes without suggesting improper benefit.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Norway's oil exports jumped significantly in March, pushing revenues to multi-year highs as disruptions from the Iran war and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz drove up prices.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/business/2026/04/15/norways-crude-oil-exports-up-68-in-march-due-to-iran-war",
    "unbiased_text": "Norway's oil exports increased 68% in March, with revenues reaching multi-year highs as global prices rose due to supply disruptions from the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz closure."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Corruption scandal domestic contrast framing",
    "detail": "Juxtaposing a leader's international progressive positioning with domestic scandals to suggest hypocrisy or distraction tactics.",
    "debias": "Report international positions and domestic issues separately without implying one is meant to obscure the other.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Pedro Sánchez is positioning himself as the ultimate progressive hero, famously defying Donald Trump over the war in Iran. But at home, the Spanish prime minister is fighting a massive wave of domestic corruption scandals.",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/15/watch-shadows-over-spain-will-corruption-topple-sanchez",
    "unbiased_text": "Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has opposed US policy on Iran while facing multiple corruption investigations involving his administration domestically."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Jet fuel crisis deadline countdown",
    "detail": "Emphasizing specific short-term depletion timelines for critical resources to heighten urgency and crisis perception.",
    "debias": "Report supply concerns with context on reserve levels, alternative sources, and industry contingency planning.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Europe has six weeks of jet fuel left caused by 'dire strait' crisis, IEA chief warns",
    "example_url": "http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/16/europe-has-six-weeks-of-jet-fuel-left-caused-by-dire-strait-crisis-iea-chief-warns",
    "unbiased_text": "The IEA chief warned that Europe's jet fuel reserves are limited due to reduced tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, with some estimates suggesting current consumption rates could deplete stocks within six weeks without resupply."
  }
]
